'''Lar'omx''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Shadows of a Black Sun" /> At some point, Lar'omx betrayed and humiliated his fellow Trandoshan clansman [[Tray'Essek]]. In accordance with traditional Trandoshan beliefs, Tray'Essek's [[Jagannath point/Legends|jagannath points]] were zeroed out, leaving him outcast from Trandoshan society and without a place in the afterlife, and he vowed to have revenge against Lar'omx.<ref name="Tray'Essex's Character Portfolio">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=ffg_content/StarWarsRPG/edge-of-the-empire/core-book/free-rpg-day/characters/TreyEssek%20LoRes.pdf|text=Tray'Essex's Character Portfolio}}</ref> Having forsaken Trandoshan traditions, Lar'omx later fell in with the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] under the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Crime lord/Legends|underboss]] [[Verannis]].<ref name="Shadows of a Black Sun" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Tray'Essek and a group of operatives loyal to the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] stole some encrypted date from Black Sun regarding the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]]. Verannis, Lar'omx and several Black Sun enforcers subsequently encountered the Pyke operatives in the [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] establishment the [[Spyder]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the operatives attempted to convince the underboss that it was in Black Sun's interests the help them to hunt down Leeachos.<ref name="Shadows of a Black Sun" />

{{RPG|''[[Under a Black Sun]]''}}
Verannis was unconvinced by the agents' argument and he set Lar'omx and two other Black Sun enforcers against them. Tray'Essek and Pyke Syndicate operatives then engaged Lar'omx and his comrades in a brief fight, and the Pyke agents ultimately defeated them.<ref name="Shadows of a Black Sun" />
{{Endgame}}
